description: Primary-source literature for Continual Decision Model, with mechanisms, evaluated tasks, and recorded reading depth.
year_convention: Year of the cited edition or initial release recorded in inspected_sections; preprint and publication years can differ.

papers.title: Long Short-Term Memory
papers.mechanism: Gated memory cells preserve error flow across long temporal dependencies.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic tasks with long delays and varied input representations.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes the foundational gated-state ancestor.
papers.inspected_sections: Original paper hosted by the authors' institution, PDF page 1 abstract.

papers.title: Neural Turing Machines
papers.mechanism: A neural controller accesses external memory through differentiable attention.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Copying, sorting, and associative recall.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes learned read-write memory as architectural prior art.
papers.inspected_sections: arXiv abstract, v2.

papers.title: Hybrid computing using a neural network with dynamic external memory
papers.mechanism: Differentiable memory combines content lookup, temporal links, and usage-based allocation.
papers.demonstrated_scope: Synthetic question answering, graph reasoning, and reinforcement-learning block puzzles.
papers.cdm_relevance: Precedes structured memory organization and stored plans.
papers.inspected_sections: Original paper PDF mirrored at https://gwern.net/doc/reinforcement-learning/model-free/2016-graves.pdf, pages 1-4; publisher page failed to load.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need

papers.demonstrated_scope: Machine translation and English constituency parsing.
papers.cdm_relevance: Establishes a content-addressable interaction baseline.
papers.inspected_sections: arXiv abstract and bibliographic metadata, v7.

papers.title: Relational recurrent neural networks

papers.demonstrated_scope: Partially observed reinforcement learning, program evaluation, and language modeling.
papers.cdm_relevance: Directly precedes relational persistent workspaces.
papers.inspected_sections: https://arxiv.org/html/1806.01822v2, Section 3 architecture and Sections 5-6 observations.

papers.title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models Beyond a Fixed-Length Context

papers.title: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention

papers.demonstrated_scope: Sequence modeling and autoregressive efficiency experiments.

papers.inspected_sections: arXiv abstract, v3.

papers.title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

papers.title: Block-Recurrent Transformers

papers.title: Universal Transformers
papers.mechanism: Shared self-attentive transformations recur across depth, with dynamic halting for individual positions.

papers.mechanism: Learns the number of computational steps while balancing prediction accuracy, computational cost, and generalization.
